bounty.crime.value: Conspiracy against Jujutsu Society, and the death of a teacher at Jujutsu Academy
Conspiracy against Jujutsu Society
Knowingly working alongside cursed spirits against sorcerers
The deaths of civilians in numbers the veil could not cover
Tearing veils down over populated ground, repeatedly and on purpose
Theft of a sealed cursed object from a clan vault
The slaughter of a branch family, in their own compound
Abducting students from a Jujutsu Academy campus
Trafficking cursed tools to people with no business holding them
Carrying a sealed object of a Special Grade and refusing to surrender it
Carrying out executions in the name of a clan that disowned them
Taking sorcerer corpses from the morgue before they could be burned
Desertion from an active mission, leaving a squad to be killed
Research into the binding of human beings as shikigami
Opening a Domain Expansion inside a city, without clearance
Hunting registered sorcerers for the technique in them
Impersonating an Academy official to gain access to a restricted site
Extorting a client under threat of letting a curse finish its work
Breaking a binding vow witnessed by three clan heads
Burning the regional registry, and everything in it
Blackmailing half a prefecture's sorcerers with what they did on missions
Deliberately cultivating curses in a residential district
Sealing another sorcerer inside an object and refusing to say which
Ritual murder, performed to a pattern nobody has placed yet

bounty.briefing.value: They have previously worked with curses, and are expected to utilise them for their own benefit in combat.
They are to be executed immediately; arrest is not an option. The Academy thanks you for your assistance in containing this threat, and will reward you accordingly.
Full information on the technique and its functionality can be examined in a hand-out manual given to anyone who wishes to take this bounty.
Additional public resources are posted as warning for those who may accidentally cross their path.
Last seen moving west along the old line, on foot, unhurried. Nobody who saw them has been able to say why they did not run.
Do not attempt negotiation. Three people have tried and the Academy has stopped counting what it cost them.
A squad is recommended. A squad has been recommended twice before, and twice the recommendation was ignored.
What remains of the previous team is available for examination, with the appropriate clearance.
Keep this quiet. A public panic in that district would do more damage than the target has managed so far.
They have made no attempt to hide, and the Academy does not believe this is confidence. It believes they are waiting for something.
Proof is required. A claim without it will not be paid, whatever the claimant's rank.
A veil will be maintained over the area for the duration. Do not rely on it holding.
They are living under a civilian identity and have neighbours who like them. Conduct yourself accordingly.
They were, until recently, staff. Several people taking this bounty will have been taught by them.
Grade restrictions on this posting are not advisory. They were written after the last time they were treated as advisory.
Containment is preferred to a kill, if containment is genuinely available. The Academy does not expect it to be.

bounty.warning.value: Despite the target's ranking, the threat they present is assessed a full grade higher. Please be careful.
They hold a Domain Expansion and have used it on open ground.
Reverse Cursed Technique is confirmed. Wounds that would stop anyone else will not stop them.
They field shikigami, and the ones seen so far are not thought to be all of them.
Black Flash has been observed more than once, which rules out luck.
They are armed with at least one cursed tool taken from a clan vault.
Simple Domain, and the discipline to use it rather than escalate.
They work out an opponent's technique inside a single exchange. Plan for the second exchange, not the first.
Their technique has no visible tell. Nobody who has fought them agrees on what it does.
They do not pursue. They wait, and they are extremely good at waiting.
A binding vow is suspected, which would explain the inconsistencies in the accounts.
Heavenly Restriction. No cursed energy at all, and it has not slowed them down.
A Maximum Technique has been used in the field and the ground has not recovered.
They are most dangerous in a crowd, and they know it.

bounty.objective.value: Kill or contain. Either is acceptable; neither is optional.
Recover what they are carrying, intact.
Confirm the identity before anything else. The Academy has been wrong once already.
Keep it off civilian cameras. The veil team cannot cover what gets uploaded.
Establish who they have been working with, and bring that name back.
Do not let them reach the site. Everything else is secondary.
Take them alive. The Academy wants to ask them something.
Destroy the research, wherever they have been keeping it.
Locate them. Engagement is not authorised on this posting.
Recover anyone they are still holding, first.

bounty.issuer.value: A clan head, through the Academy
